title: Energy-Based Physics-Informed Form Finding for Clustered Tensegrity Structures
abstract: arXiv:2607.12888v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Tensegrity form-finding and physical property prediction are fundamental problems in structural mechanics, which aim to determine equilibrium configurations and internal force distributions. These problems are challenging due to strong nonlinearity arising from the coupling between geometry and forces, and the need to satisfy equilibrium, stability, and structural constraints. This paper proposes an energy-based learning approach for clustered tensegrity form finding and physical property prediction. The proposed approach incorporates total potential energy minimization and constitutive relations into the training objective, enabling the prediction of equilibrium nodal configurations and the reconstruction of physical quantities such as member forces and force densities. translated_title: 基于能量的物理信息聚类张拉整体结构找形方法
translated_abstract: 张拉整体结构的找形与物理特性预测是结构力学中的基本问题，其目标在于确定平衡构型和内力分布。由于几何与力之间的耦合产生强非线性，并且需要满足平衡、稳定性和结构约束，这些问题极具挑战性。本文提出了一种基于能量的学习方法，用于聚类张拉整体结构的找形与物理特性预测。该方法将总势能最小化和本构关系纳入训练目标，能够预测平衡节点构型，并重构构件内力和力密度等物理量。通过将基于能量的物理损失直接集成到学习过程中，该方法在促进物理一致性的同时，将数据驱动学习与物理原理相结合……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出一种基于能量的学习方法，将总势能最小化与本构关系融入训练目标，实现了聚类张拉整体结构的平衡构型预测以及构件内力、力密度等物理量的重构。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an energy-based learning approach that embeds total potential energy minimization and constitutive relations into the training objective, enabling prediction of equilibrium nodal configurations and reconstruction of physical quantities such as member forces and force densities for clustered tensegrity structures.
